title: Least-privilege database access requirement
description: Which database role a component connects as and what that role may do (ADR-0014, ADR-0052).

role.description: The PostgreSQL login role used for the connection.

ddl-allowed.description: Whether the role may change the schema.

schema-owner.description: The role that owns the schema.

migrations-applied-by.description: The only path that applies EF Core migrations.

credential-source.description: Where the connection string or password comes from.
